brief:
Palestinian officials expressed concern that the Gaza ceasefire agreement may falter during the transition to its second phase, the Ma'an news agency reported. The shift to phase two represents a critical juncture in implementing the wider accord and has drawn scrutiny from Palestinian leadership monitoring the deal's progress.

The transition between phases typically involves new negotiations and enforcement mechanisms. Palestinians have long sought assurances that initial agreements would translate into sustained commitments, particularly regarding reconstruction and the terms governing subsequent stages of any broader settlement arrangement in the territory.
title: Palestinians fear Gaza ceasefire deal stalls at phase two transition
